 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Inter Miami visits New England tonight in a top-of-the-table Eastern Conference matchup.
 The Herons are coming off a 2-2 draw against Cincinnati, and Lionel Messi & co. will be looking to bounce back, with the result potentially carrying playoff seeding implications.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Messi will, as always, be key to Miami's performance. The Argentine surprisingly picked up his fifth yellow card of the season in the previous match. Under MLS rules, players who accumulate five yellow cards are automatically handed a one-match suspension.
 However, Messi is available for tonight's game despite reaching that threshold because of a unique MLS rule.
 Why Was Lionel Messi Not Suspended?
 While a fifth yellow card triggers an automatic one-game ban, Messi remains eligible to play tonight because of the MLS Good Behavior Incentive.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement HARRISON, NEW JERSEY – OCTOBER 24: Lionel Messi is challenged by Sekou Koné #60 of Red Bull New York during the MLS match between Red Bull New York and Inter Miami CF at Sports Illustrated Stadium on October 24, 2026 in Harrison, New Jersey. (Photo by Jordan Bank/MLS via Getty Images)Jordan Bank / Getty Images
 Under this rule, a player automatically removes one yellow card from their total if they go five consecutive matches without receiving a booking or a red card.
 The 39-year-old has completed two separate five-match clean streaks earlier, and two yellow cards were wiped from the total. Currently his official MLS yellow cards total stands at only three, keeping him safe from a suspension.
 Lionel Messi MLS Stats This Season for Inter Miami
 Similar to last season, Messi has been the biggest factor behind Miami's success during the 2026-27 campaign as well.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Argentinian has played 29 matches so far, scoring 25 goals and providing 15 assists, making a total of 40 goal contributions. He also leads the race for the golden boot with 25 goals, three more than FC Dallas' Peter Musa. Messi is also tied with Son Heung-min with 15 assists so far this season.
